faq.q: What is a titanium fuel cell end plate?
faq.a: A titanium fuel cell end plate is a precision-machined hydrogen hardware component used in hydrogen fuel cell stack end pressure plate. Manufactured from Grade 2 CP-Ti for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What is the typical application for titanium fuel cell end plate?
faq.a: Titanium Fuel Cell End Plate is designed for hydrogen fuel cell stack end pressure plate. The Grade 2 CP-Ti grade is selected to provide the optimal balance of strength, fatigue life, and environmental resistance for this specific application.

faq.q: How is titanium fuel cell end plate manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Fuel Cell End Plate is manufactured using Seamless tube extrusion. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium fuel cell end plate?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.
